from collections import Counter
p='inputs/SRR35233585_raw_variants.vcf'
trans={frozenset(x) for x in ('AG','CT')}
for mode in ('all','pass'):
    c=Counter(); rec=0; selected=0; alleles=0; genotypes=Counter(); multi=0
    with open(p) as fh:
        for line in fh:
            if line.startswith('#'): continue
            f=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t'); rec+=1
            if mode=='pass' and f[6] not in ('.','PASS'): continue
            gt=f[9].split(':')[0]; genotypes[gt]+=1
            for ai in {int(x) for x in gt.replace('|','/').split('/') if x not in ('.','') and x"'!='"'0'}:
                alts=f[4].split(',')
                if ai>len(alts): raise ValueError((f[0],f[1],gt))
                ref,alt=f[3].upper(),alts[ai-1].upper()
                if len(ref)==len(alt)==1 and ref in 'ACGT' and alt in 'ACGT' and ref"'!=alt:
                    alleles += 1; selected += 1
                    c['"'Ts' if frozenset((ref,alt)) in trans else 'Tv'] += 1
            if ',' in f[4]: multi+=1
    print(mode, 'records',rec,'selected_snv_alt_alleles',selected,'Ts',c['Ts'],'Tv',c['Tv'],'ratio',c['Ts']/c['Tv'] if c['Tv'] else None,'multi',multi,'GTs',genotypes)
PY"

from collections import Counter
p='inputs/SRR35233585_raw_variants.vcf'
base=set('ACGT')
trans={frozenset(('A','G')), frozenset(('C','T'))}
for mode in ('all_alt_once','sample_alt_once','sample_site_once'):
    c=Counter(); records=0; included_records=0; included_alts=0; gt_counts=Counter(); skipped=Counter(); multiallelic=0
    with open(p) as fh:
        for line in fh:
            if line.startswith('#'): continue
            f=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t'); records+=1
            ref=f[3].upper(); alts=f[4].upper().split(',')
            gt=f[9].split(':',1)[0] if len(f)>9 else './.'
            gt_counts[gt]+=1
            if mode=='all_alt_once':
                idxs=range(len(alts))
            else:
                toks=gt.replace('|','/').split('/')
                idxs=sorted({int(x) for x in toks if x not in ('.','0','')})
                if not idxs: continue
            if len(alts)>1: multiallelic+=1
            rec_has=False
            for i in idxs:
                if i<1 or i>len(alts):
                    skipped['bad_gt_index']+=1; continue
                alt=alts[i-1]
                if len(ref)==1 and len(alt)==1 and ref in base and alt in base and ref"'!=alt:
                    rec_has=True; included_alts+=1
                    c['"'Ts' if frozenset((ref,alt)) in trans else 'Tv']+=1
                else: skipped['non_snv']+=1
            if rec_has: included_records+=1
    ratio=c['Ts']/c['Tv']
    print(mode, 'records',records, 'included_records',included_records, 'included_alt_alleles',included_alts, 'Ts',c['Ts'],'Tv',c['Tv'], 'ratio',f'{ratio:.12f}', 'multi',multiallelic, 'skipped',dict(skipped), 'GTs',gt_counts)
PY"

from collections import Counter
p='inputs/SRR35233585_raw_variants.vcf'
base=set('ACGT'); trans={frozenset(('A','G')),frozenset(('C','T'))}
for desc, get_indices in [
    ('first_alt_for_every_record', lambda gt,alts:[1]),
    ('first_called_alt_only', lambda gt,alts:[1] if '1' in gt.replace('|','/').split('/') else []),
    ('one_site_classification_first_called', lambda gt,alts:[next((int(x) for x in gt.replace('|','/').split('/') if x not in ('0','.','')),0)]),
]:
    c=Counter(); n=0; snv=0; types=Counter(); multi=Counter()
    for line in open(p):
        if line.startswith('#'): continue
        f=line.rstrip().split('\\t'); gt=f[9].split(':',1)[0]; alts=f[4].split(',')
        idxs=get_indices(gt,alts)
        for i in idxs:
            if not i or i>len(alts): continue
            ref=f[3].upper(); alt=alts[i-1].upper()
            if len(ref)==len(alt)==1 and ref in base and alt in base and ref"'!=alt:
                c['"'Ts' if frozenset((ref,alt)) in trans else 'Tv']+=1; n+=1
                if len(alts)>1: multi['snv']+=1
            else:
                if len(alts)>1: multi['nonsnv']+=1
    print(desc, c, 'ratio',c['Ts']/c['Tv'],'n',n,'multi',multi)
PY"
